note: The burnets, Joe Pye weeds and salvias audited for 0.9.160. The burnets and Joe Pyes were redrawn and filled out; the salvias were redrawn only. Sizes are a nursery's or a garden's figure; where two disagree, the estimate says which was taken and why. heightIn is the plant in flower.

sources.ddog: Digging Dog Nursery, Sanguisorba listing (every selection's own page, e.g. https://www.diggingdog.com/plant/P-2193), read 2026-11-24
sources.mbg: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder, https://plantfinder.mobot.org/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=<id>, read 2026-11-24
sources.gardenia: Gardenia.net plant pages (USDA zones and heights), seen in search results 2026-11-24; the site refuses fetches

greatburnet|arnhem.estimates: DD 5-6 ft x 2-2.5 ft; RHS 1.5-2.5 m. Took DD's midpoint. 'Lean branching stems ... a see-through froth of snug ovoid blooms'.

greatburnet|chocolatetip.estimates: DD 2.25 ft x 16 in. Egg-shaped maroon heads that open from the bottom up; blue-green foliage burnished chocolate.

greatburnet|morningselect.estimates: DD 2.5-3.5 ft x 16-18 in; early blooming.

greatburnet|pinktanna.estimates: DD 18-24 in, gardenia 2-3 ft, RHS 0.5-1 m. Took DD's upper figure. Listed both as Sanguisorba 'Pink Tanna' (RHS, DD) and as S. officinalis 'Pink Tanna' (RHS Plants); recorded as a hybrid with no wild range. Muted pink catkins with pale rose stamens, russet with age; canary-yellow autumn leaves.

greatburnet|blackthorn.estimates: DD 5-6 ft, RHS 1-1.5 m, gardenia 36-60 in. Took 5 ft, between DD and the others. Long upright rosy-red heads with black-tipped stamens.

greatburnet|redthunder.estimates: Existing record (42 in) kept; DD 3-4 ft. Note now says bobbles, DD's word, not bottlebrushes.

greatburnet|tanna.estimates: Existing record (16 in) kept; DD 18 in x 12 in.

menziesburnet|wakeup.estimates: DD 2-3 ft x 16-18 in. Tassels longer and fluffier than the species, pinkish maroon, over blue-grey leaves.

obtusaburnet.estimates: DD 2.5 ft x 18 in, gardenia 2-3 ft, RHS 1-1.5 m (a UK figure). Zones 4-8 from gardenia and DD's hardy to zone 4. Endemic to Japan's mountains. Soft pink fluffy fingers nodding on arching stems.

narrowleafburnet.estimates: No source read gives the straight species' size: taken from its forms, DD 'Alba' 4-5 ft and 'Pink Elephant' 3-5 ft, RHS 'Purpurea' 1-1.5 m. Japan, Korea, China and the Russian Far East. Drawn in the red-purple of the type.

narrowleafburnet|alba.estimates: DD 4-5 ft x 18-24 in; RHS 1.5-2.5 m. White, drooping, cylindrical; RHS treats it as var. alba.

narrowleafburnet|pinkelephant.estimates: DD 3-5 ft x 2-3 ft. Raspberry heads held near level, curving down with age; light pink stamens.

narrowleafburnet|burrblanc.estimates: DD 4-5 ft x 18-24 in. A seedling selected at Marchants from S. tenuifolia var. parviflora plants, called a hybrid there; recorded with no wild range.

spottedjoepye.estimates: MBG 4-7 ft x 3-4 ft. Purple-speckled stems, leaves in whorls of 3-6, flat-topped heads. Tolerates deer, clay, wet soil (MBG).

spottedjoepye|riesenschirm.estimates: MBG 5-6 ft x 2-3 ft; deep purple stems.

sweetjoepye.estimates: MBG 5-7 ft x 2-4 ft, sun to part shade, medium water; green stems purple at the nodes, leaves in whorls of 3-4, vanilla-scented domed heads.

hollowjoepye.estimates: MBG 4-7 ft x 2-4 ft, dusky rose. Took MBG's midpoint although the species is often said to be the tallest Joe Pye: no other source was read.

hollowjoepye|atropurpurea.estimates: MBG files 'Atropurpurea' under E. fistulosum: 4-7 ft, rose-purple, zones 3-8.

coastaljoepye.estimates: MBG 3-5 ft x 2-4 ft, pale pink to dark purple.

coastaljoepye|littlejoe.estimates: MBG 3-4 ft x 1-3 ft; mauve purple.

phantomjoepye.estimates: MBG 2-4 ft x 1-2 ft, wine red. MBG names it Eutrochium 'Phantom' with no species: recorded as a hybrid with no wild range.

joepye.estimates: Existing record kept (54 in; MBG 4-5 ft).

babyjoe.estimates: Existing record kept (30 in; MBG 2-3 ft).

roles.browse: MBG lists Deer under Tolerate on every Eutrochium page read (the four species, 'Gateway', 'Baby Joe', 'Little Joe', 'Phantom'), so the whole joepye group joined BROWSE_RESIST_GROUPS.
roles.rain: The rain garden lists already read for 0.9.132 (rain-sources.json) name E. maculatum (5 lists), E. purpureum (4) and E. dubium (1, in the basin); spotted, sweet and coastal plain Joe Pye take the Rain garden role by its rule. No list names E. fistulosum.
